diagnosis.root_cause: addons/base/rng/common.rng <rng:define name="field"> on the target image (odoo17-odoo 17.0-20251222) omits <rng:optional><rng:attribute name="help"/></rng:optional>; the local image (17.0-20260630) has it. tree_view.rng validates fields through that shared definition, so a help attribute on a tree column is accepted locally and rejected on the target.
evidence: common.rng field-define help attribute count: local 4, target 3 (byte-level diff on the same define).

Whole-repository scan of RNG-validated view types (tree/list/search/kanban/pivot/graph/calendar/gantt/activity) at HEAD a2c39711 finds exactly one field with help: smart_construction_core/views/core/cost_domain_views.xml view_project_progress_entry_tree name=progress_rate.

The committed baseline contracts/generated/product_view_structure_contract.json stores that node as {"attrs":{"name":"progress_rate","type":"float"},"tag":"field"} with value_sha256 a2084c5e4d1b86947e16f70bda1c79902e91248a0dbdaa89c3c1a95a12de2bde, i.e. without help; PR #654 added the attribute to the XML without regenerating the baseline, so the code silently drifted from its own contract.
diagnosis.fix: Remove the help attribute from that single native list column so the resolved structure equals the authoritative committed baseline again. The tooltip is only a list-header tooltip; the python field label/documentation is untouched and no capability is removed. Revisit only if the owner chooses to upgrade the target base image so help is supported.
diagnosis.impact: No other RNG-validated view node carries help, so no further view change is required for the target upgrade to pass.

second_defect_fix.title: Locked-menu release initialization must honor the declared delivery rule for the preview product
second_defect_fix.layer: P1 construction industry standard product (smart_construction_core locked menu policy contract + release snapshot initialization)
second_defect_fix.discovered_by: Target-environment deployment attempt at candidate 45796be9: after the RUNTIME-BOUNDARY-FIX-02 view fix let the smart_construction_core upgrade succeed, make daily.runtime.published_face.converge failed at the construction.preview snapshot step
second_defect_fix.evidence: ssh sc-root 'make release.daily_product_navigation.converge' -> construction.standard PASS (snapshot_id 97) then LockedMenuPolicyContractError LOCKED_MENU_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH: construction.preview contains non-released snapshot page
second_defect_fix.root_cause: PR #654 introduced the new locked P1 product definition (addons/smart_construction_core/data/formal_business_product_menu_policy_v1.json) whose product_policy_profiles/delivery_rule declares 'standard includes formally released entries; preview includes released plus explicitly preview entries'. construction.preview is therefore 90 released + 39 declared preview entries. The frozen-snapshot post gate in scripts/release/initialize_colocated_platform_snapshot.py still called the released-only assertion assert_snapshot_matches_locked_contract, which rejects any preview page, so the published face could no longer converge. PR #654 changed the baseline but not the initializer.
second_defect_fix.why_not_baseline: The delivery rule and the 39 preview entries are explicit, LOCKED P1 declarations (source product_menu_source.json entries[] release_state + product_policy_profiles[].included_release_states). The runtime already consumes the tolerant caliber: scripts/verify/production_menu_release_gate_guard.py - the authority deciding whether an entry may be opened - calls assert_snapshot_matches_policy_release_states. Only the initializer lagged, so the mechanism, not the declared fact, was wrong.
second_defect_fix.fix: scripts/release/initialize_colocated_platform_snapshot.py now gates the frozen snapshot with assert_snapshot_matches_policy_release_states(contract, product_key, pages, policy.menu_groups): no page outside {released, preview}, released pages equal to the locked baseline exactly, preview pages equal to the policy's declared preview set exactly. Report keys keep snapshot_menu_count = released count (unchanged meaning) and add snapshot_preview_page_count / snapshot_effective_page_count.
second_defect_fix.not_weakened: An undeclared or hidden/retired page still fails closed (others check, and the preview additions/missing check). Verified locally against the real baseline: construction.standard released=90 preview=0 PASS; construction.preview released=90 preview=39 PASS on the declared caliber while the released-only gate reports LOCKED_MENU_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH.

third_defect_fix.fix: 两处断言都改为按锁定 P1 产品定义的声明口径：snapshot_released_page_count == policy_released_menu_count；snapshot_preview_page_count == policy_preview_menu_count；gate_page_count == policy_released_menu_count + policy_preview_menu_count。products 记录新增 policy_preview_menu_count / snapshot_preview_page_count。
third_defect_fix.not_weakened: 未声明的 preview 或对不上的 preview 计数仍 fail-closed；released 页仍必须严格等于策略声明；gate 页数必须等于有效总量。新增两条反例测试：合法 preview 口径被接受；gate 忽略声明 preview 被拒。
